title: Side head, shot card
summary: The approved h1 cast at 120px in GoNimbly's side composition (lede behind a hairline beside the short first line; the action on line 2's baseline) from a 1280 stage up, stacked below it, with no kicker, no breadcrumb and no facts box, and a full-measure shot card under it that doubles as the shoot brief for the page's footage.

reference.site: GoNimbly (founder's recordings, refs-r9) on the approved interior header X
reference.borrowed: Headline left, a short line behind a vertical hairline, one quiet action, the picture directly under the head at full measure.
reference.kelwin: Kit §12.3/12.4: two-voice h1, the 48×2 rule, a shot card instead of footage (no take, no timecode), flat graphite.

motion: entrance: the turn lifts, the h1 writes itself in (kit §13), the hairline draws down with the rule, the lede and action rise, the plate rises and widens.
notes: Round 8's CONTOUR band, the facts box and the crumb are gone. Round 9 fix: the side composition collided between 1024 and 1279 (line 2 under the action, the lede's third line into line 2), so it now holds only from 1280 up (and always on the 1440 review stage); the section clips its own x-overflow (the mockup bar's hidden menu). The shot card's brief drops the jargon ('frosted like the homepage film') and its spec line carries numerals and units only ('12 s · 2.52 : 1', unit kept lowercase). The brief is for the founder to confirm or rewrite. Coherence pass 3: h1 words unchanged (the homepage ledger's line); phone floor 40 (kit 12.3) so “the market hears.” holds one line at 390 and 360 — at 56 “hears.” stood alone. At 320 it still does (it would need 35px); listed.
